reviewers.summary: The added URL setting covers production targets only when it is configured. With that setting absent, a production target can bypass isolation approval.

findingList.message: A01:2025 Broken Access Control: production isolation can still be bypassed when the production target URL is not listed in the optional environment setting. Require authoritative production classification before accepting a target.

evidence.codePathTraced: build_load_run_config calls _production_target; when FLUXION_LOAD_TARGET_ENV is not production, _production_target recognizes production only if FLUXION_LOAD_PRODUCTION_TARGET_URL is set to the exact target URL.
evidence.failureScenario: A caller targets a production service on a neutral hostname, leaves FLUXION_LOAD_PRODUCTION_TARGET_URL unset, and sets FLUXION_LOAD_TARGET_ENV to test. _production_target returns false, so the config is returned without isolation approval.

reviewers.summary: The added production URL setting catches an exact match, but equivalent URL spellings can bypass that check. The other changes since the prior review address the earlier parameter-test findings.

findingList.message: A01:2025 Broken Access Control: exact URL string matching misses equivalent production URLs. Normalize the URL before comparing it with the configured production target.

evidence.codePathTraced: _production_target classifies the target by exact string equality with FLUXION_LOAD_PRODUCTION_TARGET_URL. _safe_target_url accepts an uppercase HTTPS scheme because urlsplit normalizes the parsed scheme.
evidence.failureScenario: With FLUXION_LOAD_PRODUCTION_TARGET_URL set to https://service.example/api/v1 and no isolation approval, a caller supplies HTTPS://service.example/api/v1. The URL passes validation but fails the exact comparison, so configuration is returned for the production endpoint without approval.

reviewers.summary: The updated check catches a neutral-host production URL only when that exact URL is configured. Without the optional setting, the outstanding production approval bypass remains.

findingList.message: A01:2025 Broken Access Control: production isolation can still be bypassed when the production target is not listed in the optional production URL setting and its environment label is absent or non-production. Require an authoritative classification for every accepted target.

evidence.codePathTraced: _production_target requires either FLUXION_LOAD_TARGET_ENV to be production or FLUXION_LOAD_PRODUCTION_TARGET_URL to exactly match target_url. The production URL setting is optional.
evidence.failureScenario: A run supplies a production service URL with a neutral hostname, while FLUXION_LOAD_TARGET_ENV is unset or set to test and FLUXION_LOAD_PRODUCTION_TARGET_URL is unset. The check returns false, so the config is accepted without isolation approval.
